title: calling toString on random objects can cause errors in IE
body: **Describe the bug 🐛** A clear and concise description of what the bug is. **To Reproduce 🔍** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Go to IE11 2. see an error A live example helps a lot! We have a simple online template for you to use for your explanations: for now: https://nopproj.computeruniverse.net/de/search?cid=0&query= **Expected behavior 💭** No errors **Screenshots 🖥** **Environment:** - OS: Windows - Browser: IE - Version: 11 **Additional context** toString.call can not be called on a string in IE, we should check for that first https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/9dca5480d27265a92f9e0f0cc7405b1c33badd0e/src/lib/utils/isPlainObject.ts#L11

comments.body: update, looks like `toString.call({})` also throws, not just strings, we should find another way for doing this
